purpose: Large product-engineering waves with deterministic cheap controls during implementation, one source-bound milestone proof, and one final world-class output matrix after all six surfaces are frozen.
truthBoundary: Quick/domain gates verify source, corpus and contracts only. Milestone needs exact installed dependencies. The 2700-row matrix remains NOT_EXECUTED until product adapters, build and runtime are frozen. Offline fixtures never prove staging or LIVE.

cadence.quick: Once after a coherent product wave, not after every file.
cadence.domain: Once after completing an entire product/build/database/i18n/source domain.
cadence.milestone: Once after exact runtime/cache is restored and PASS16 implementation is frozen.
cadence.release: Once for the source-bound production candidate before browser/WCAG/PDF proof.
cadence.worldclassMatrix: Generate all 2700 outputs once after six surfaces are frozen; after fixes rerun failed slices, then one final full matrix.

forbiddenShortcuts: Do not count the prepared 300-case corpus as executed outputs.
Do not count historical PASS4640 rows as PASS16 canonical results.
Do not count static lazy-boundary checks as successful build.
Do not rerun unchanged heavy gates.
Do not release Pro/Advanced without source, freshness, license, entitlement and human-authority gates where required.
Do not raise staging/LIVE percentages from offline fixtures or inherited receipts.
